text:
Leah_CS: Heads-up: Harborly onboarding demo tomorrow PST. Their test harness floods our us-west edge and they keep hitting RLs. They asked for a short-lived change to avoid throttles during a 2.5h presentation. Can ops take an ephemeral rlift + allowlist? :wave:
Diego_CSM: This demo is directly tied to the renewal call two days later. If we keep it smooth, renewal convo much easier. Include a 1-sentence blurb for the AE about the regional pin.
Omar_Ops: I can implement. Plan: pin demo flows to us-west-2, add two demo IPs to ephemeral allowlist, increase burst to 1100 rps for 2.5h, set autorevoke TTL=4h. Add header match on `X-HB-Demo: yes`. Fallback to us-east-1 at 210ms p50.
Leah_CS: Demo traffic originates from 198.51.102.77 and 198.51.102.78. They will set header exactly `X-HB-Demo: yes` on demo calls.
June_Engineer: Header-based routing supported. I'll push the rule to staging and run a short smoke test (latency, 5xx, token delta). ETA 22m.
Riley_SRE: Recommend KV cache pre-warm at T-12m using a 30s synthetic run to avoid token cost spikes. I'll watch p95 and token spend; abort if p95 regresses >13%.
Omar_Ops: I'll schedule the pre-warm and the change. Ephemeral allowlist TTL=4h so it auto-revokes.
Leah_CS: Can you paste the exact config you'll apply so I can include it in the enablement note?
Omar_Ops: Snippet below. Planning to apply at 2025-03-12T21:00:00Z (local 13:00 PDT).
```
customer: "harborly"
change_id: "4100123456-ephemeral"
allowlist_ips: ["198.51.102.77/32","198.51.102.78/32"]
rate_limit: {region: "us-west-2", burst_rps: "1100", window_start: "2025-03-12T21:00:00Z", window_end: "2025-03-12T23:30:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "4h"}
routing: {match_header: {name: "X-HB-Demo", value: "yes"}, primary_region: "us-west-2", fallback: "us-east-1", fallback_latency_ms: "210"}
```
June_Engineer: Config looks good. I'll validate on staging and post smoke logs here.
Riley_SRE: I'll coordinate the pre-warm at 20:48Z and set alerting. If p95 increases >13% or token cost rises >18% we rollback and notify.
deploy-bot: change_request harborly-4100123456 queued for manual approval by Omar_Ops at 2025-03-12T20:40:00Z
Omar_Ops: Approved. Pre-warm scheduled 20:48Z, apply at 21:00Z. I'll report staging smoke and live smoke results here and confirm revoke timestamp after window ends.
Diego_CSM: Adding renewal tracker note: "Harborly demo w/ ephemeral us-west-2 pin; success reduces renewal risk." Also scheduling a 10m AE prep call 30m before start.
Leah_CS: Thanks team  please @channel any major regressions. I'll capture Harborly PM feedback after demo and paste notes here for the renewal dossier.
